stage_b_reviewed_content.statement:
Let $X$ be a topological space.
The category of abelian sheaves on $X$ has enough injectives.
In fact it has functorial injective embeddings.
conclusions:
The category of abelian sheaves on $X$ has enough injectives.
In fact it has functorial injective embeddings.

reason: Embed sheaf stalks functorially into injective abelian groups and form their product of skyscraper sheaves; the stalk/skyscraper adjunction proves each skyscraper injective and products preserve injectivity.
